title: Report: Alibaba Internally Testing AI Office Platform 'Wan You Wu Jie': Multiple Digital Employees Work in Teams
excerpt: According to a report by "Dujia," dated August 3, Alibaba Cloud is currently testing a B-end platform called "Wanyou Wujie" that focuses on human and Agent coll
content_html:
According to a report by "Dujia," dated August 3, Alibaba Cloud is currently testing a B-end platform called "Wanyou Wujie" that focuses on human and Agent collaboration. The core function of this platform is to build collaborative teams composed of multiple digital employees, working together on complete projects - effectively enabling a group of AI agents to work in a manner similar to a real team, with division of labor and joint delivery.

Different from previous products like "Qianwen Office," which focused on daily office processes, document processing, and automation scenarios, Wanyou Wujie focuses on the collaborative delivery of complex projects by multiple intelligent agents, further expanding Alibaba's AI office product matrix. Testing experiences show that freelancers and individual entrepreneurs can also find suitable application scenarios that match their needs, with particularly strong adaptability for lightweight scenarios.

Currently free for all, with tiered charging based on scale later on

All capabilities within Wanyou Wujie are currently available for free. However, according to the official plan, different versions or enterprise solutions will be provided in the future based on factors such as task size and model resource consumption - meaning that the current period is the best time to try it out.

In recent times, Alibaba's layout in the AI office field has significantly accelerated. At the beginning of July, Alibaba announced that it would integrate the capabilities of three intelligent agent products, Wukong and MuleRun, based on QoderWork, upgrading them into a more powerful enterprise-level AI product, which is now being personally managed by DingTalk CEO Chen Yusen.

content_html_zh:
据《度家》8月3日报道，阿里云目前正在测试一款名为“万有无界”的B端平台，该平台专注于人和Agent协作。 该平台的核心功能是建立由多个数字化员工组成的协作团队，共同完成完整的项目——有效地让一组AI代理以类似于真实团队的方式工作，分工协作交付。

与以往“前问办公”等专注于日常办公流程、文档处理、自动化场景的产品不同，万有无界专注于多个智能代理协同交付复杂项目，进一步拓展了阿里巴巴的AI办公产品矩阵。 测试经验表明，自由职业者和个人创业者也能找到符合自己需求的合适应用场景，尤其是对轻量级场景的适应性特别强。

目前免费，后续将根据规模分级收费

万有无界内的所有功能目前都是免费提供的。 但根据官方规划，未来将根据任务规模、模型资源消耗等因素提供不同版本或企业级解决方案——这意味着当前时期是尝试的最佳时机。

近段时间，阿里巴巴在AI办公领域的布局明显加速。 7月初，阿里巴巴宣布将基于QoderWork整合悟空、MuleRun三款智能坐席产品的能力，升级为更强大的企业级AI产品，目前由钉钉CEO陈宇森亲自管理。
